description: Repo-scale (express-js-inventory): enforce a warehouse's maxCapacity from BOTH item-creation and IN-movement mutation paths
prompts: Warehouses gain an optional `maxCapacity` field (a non-negative integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/warehouses and return it in warehouse responses. The invariant to enforce: the SUM of `quantity` across every item currently in a warehouse must never exceed that warehouse's maxCapacity (when set). This must be validated from BOTH places that can increase a warehouse's total quantity: (1) POST /api/items, when creating a new item with a non-zero initial quantity, and (2) an IN-type stock movement (POST /api/items/:itemId/movements with type "IN") - both must reject with 400 if the change would push the warehouse's total over maxCapacity. OUT movements and warehouses with maxCapacity unset are never constrained.
name: add_js_inventory_warehouse_capacity
